# Hack The Box

> > Hack The Box is a comprehensive cybersecurity training platform offering hands-on hacking labs, industry-recognized certifications, and practical skill development for offensive and defensive security professionals.

HTB provides real-world penetration testing environments through HTB Academy courses, interactive hacking labs with virtual machines, and professional certifications including CPTS, CWEE, CDSA, and CJCSA. The platform features Pwnbox for browser-based pentesting, CTF challenges, and guided learning paths for both beginners and advanced practitioners.

## Key Topics

- HTB Academy
- Penetration Testing
- Cybersecurity Certifications
- HTB Certified Penetration Testing Specialist (CPTS)
- HTB Certified Web Exploitation Specialist (CWEE)
- HTB Certified Defensive Security Analyst (CDSA)
- HTB Certified Junior Cybersecurity Associate (CJCSA)
- Pwnbox
- Hands-on Hacking Labs
- Job Role Paths
- Skill Paths
- Offensive Security
- Defensive Security
- CTF Challenges
- Ethical Hacking
